items.control_name: Enforce JWT Validation and Mutual TLS (mTLS) on OCI API Gateway
items.description: Public and internal OCI API Gateway deployments must validate JWT signatures from OCI Identity Domains / Okta and enforce mTLS for high-security endpoints.
items.current_value: 100% of API routes enforce JWT validation; mTLS active on financial transaction routes
items.recommended_value: Mandatory JWT validation and rate limiting across all API gateways
items.remediation_notes: Monitor API gateway 4xx/5xx authentication failure rates.

items.control_name: Enforce OCI Vault Secret Management & Eliminate Plain-Text Configs
items.description: Application credentials and TLS certificates must be stored in OCI Vault as secrets and retrieved via Dynamic Groups at runtime.
items.current_value: 16 secrets managed in OCI Vault; 2 microservices use plain-text environment variables
items.recommended_value: 100% OCI Vault secrets adoption with zero local plain-text storage
items.remediation_notes: Refactor 'svc-legacy-db' and 'svc-email-sender' to read credentials from OCI Vault.

items.control_name: Enable OCI Vulnerability Scanning Service on Container Registry Repositories
items.description: OCI Container Registry (OCIR) repositories must have automated vulnerability scanning enabled to flag CVEs in container base images.
items.current_value: Vulnerability Scanning Service active on 8 of 10 OCIR repositories
items.recommended_value: Continuous CVE scanning active on 100% of OCIR repositories
items.remediation_notes: Attach container scanning recipe to 'ocir-dev-tools' and 'ocir-sandbox-repo'.

items.control_name: Attach OCI WAF with API Rate Limiting and OWASP Rules to API Gateways
items.description: OCI Web Application Firewall (WAF) must protect API Gateway external load balancer endpoints against OWASP Top 10 API attacks.
items.current_value: WAF Policy 'waf-api-prod' attached to production API Gateway edge
items.recommended_value: WAF attached to 100% of public API endpoints
items.remediation_notes: Regularly review WAF bot management rules.
